purpose: Determine whether the FACETS 4.5.0 native crash is version-specific or persists in the current 4.5.1 runtime on the same Windows build.

official_product_statement.scope: Complete FACETS functionality limited to 2,000 responses

execution.install_mode: visible interactive installation to a separate MINIFAC directory
execution.first_control: unchanged MINIFAC-bundled example or FACETS-bundled Kct.txt, in isolated work and TEMP/TMP directories

decision_rule.minifac_control_pass: classify the incident as 4.5.0-version/runtime specific; do not substitute 4.5.1 for the registered comparator
decision_rule.minifac_control_fail_same_module: classify the incident as shared Xojo/Windows runtime incompatibility and prepare a vendor support packet
decision_rule.both_cases: do not aggregate preflight endpoints or execute scientific comparisons under a changed engine version

claim_boundary: MINIFAC 4.5.1 is a version-sensitivity diagnostic only and cannot replace FACETS 4.5.0 calibration evidence.
